status: SETUP_REQUIRED for actionable templates with reviewed wording or provider dependency

required_inputs.content: Actual reviewed legal/health/safety/HR/static wording or original source document; source/version/reviewer/applicability
required_inputs.identity: Actual beneficiary, payer, issuer and signatory/guardian authority; no role-label substitution
required_inputs.schema: Approved question/field/conditional logic and required stage, not AI-invented medical questions
required_inputs.financial: Original source confirmed amounts/issuer/currency/tax/receipt/credit facts, not manual unverified template totals
required_inputs.capabilities: Actual upload/scan/form/render/signature/private file and email support plus tested format/size limits
required_inputs.retention: Reviewed data/record policy and release/deletion/restore handling; no arbitrary dates

safe_defaults.placeholder_content: Blocks affected publication/issue; draft preview remains allowed
safe_defaults.unresolved_required_values: Blocks applicable stage; no invented values
safe_defaults.uploaded_signature: Original evidence with provenance/review, not new Orb signature
